title: cookie.serialize accepts names and values with spaces
prompt: cookie.serialize(name, val, options) in index.js only checks that the cookie name and value are printable header characters, so it happily produces cookies that are not valid under RFC 6265: a name such as 'foo bar' or an unencoded value such as 'foo bar' is accepted. Names should have to be valid tokens and values valid cookie-octets (optionally wrapped in double quotes); the same strictness is expected for the domain and path options without breaking ordinary values. Please make the validation follow the RFC.
